question: What is multi-hop question answering, and why is it hard for vector-only retrieval?

frames.data: data: {"type":"block","block":{"type":"CitedSummary","id":"turn-d2540216a81b","meta":{"status":"ready","error":null},"data":{"segments":[{"text":"Multi-hop question answering involves queries that require retrieving and reasoning over multiple pieces of supporting evidence, and integrating information across passages in a corpus.","citationIds":["c1","c2"]},{"text":"An example is asking for the fight song of the university whose main campus is in Lawrence, Kansas and whose branch campuses are in the Kansas City area. This requires first identifying the university from its location and then retrieving information about its fight song.","citationIds":["c3"]},{"text":"Vector-only retrieval is hard here because the basic pipeline encodes chunks as vectors and retrieves the top-k chunks by semantic similarity to the question. Basic retrievers struggle with complex queries that encode multi-aspect intentions and need multi-hop reasoning.","citationIds":["c4","c3"]},{"text":"Existing RAG systems are inadequate at multi-hop queries, and even multi-step retrieval that iterates retrieval and generation can be insufficient for some knowledge-integration scenarios.","citationIds":["c1","c2"]}],"citations":[{"id":"c1","chunkId":"743155d9b0541c99_c_6b9454acd0180e9a","docId":"743155d9b0541c99","docTitle":"2401.15391_MultiHop_RAG_Benchmarking_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation_for_Multi_Hop","page":1,"quote":"multi-hop queries, which require retrieving and reasoning over multiple pieces of supporting evidence"},{"id":"c2","chunkId":"14671c78fc7de99d_c_46510d19e232344a","docId":"14671c78fc7de99d","docTitle":"2405.14831_HippoRAG_Neurobiologically_Inspired_Long_Term_Memory_for_Large_Languag","page":2,"quote":"standard multi-hop question answering (QA) also requires integrating information between passages in a retrieval corpus."},{"id":"c3","chunkId":"737b0b8fe0aa8459_c_1d5f089b38a091ff","docId":"737b0b8fe0aa8459","docTitle":"2501.00309_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation_with_Graphs_GraphRAG","page":12,"quote":"demands multi-hop reasoning to identify the university based on location and retrieve information about its fight song"},{"id":"c4","chunkId":"396a0fadeb4cd40f_c_05a521270f216026","docId":"396a0fadeb4cd40f","docTitle":"2312.10997_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation_for_Large_Language_Models_A_Survey","page":3,"quote":"Retrieve the Top k chunks most relevant to the question based on semantic similarity."}]}}}
